This '''outpost''' was constructed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] inside of a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] on the forest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] to serve as a backup communications station should the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] system on the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] ever fail. After the second Death Star's destruction during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the remaining crew of this outpost, under the command of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Jeres Moridon]], attempted to jury-rig a HoloNet [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|transceiver]] to cut through the interference caused by the destruction of the Death Star and notify the rest of the Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] about the Empire's defeat. They were thwarted by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[operative]]s and the facility was destroyed when the volcano erupted.
